attacker_pocs.name: short-lzma2-chunk-input
attacker_pocs.why: The public .xz stream decoder receives a complete LZMA2 header declaring a one-byte compressed chunk in a 30-byte input segment. For compressed sizes below the five-byte range decoder initialization length, the new input limit extends beyond the caller's available bytes. Range decoder initialization reads the first byte past the heap allocation. The pinned parent returns without reading it.

role_a_rationale: The patch bounds the inner LZMA decoder to the chunk's declared compressed size and reports LZMA_DATA_ERROR when that limit is exhausted before the chunk finishes. Valid streams and the full 20-test ASan suite pass. A five-byte initialization allowance for undersized chunks assumes bytes exist beyond a truncated input segment, creating one new heap-buffer-overflow through the public stream API.
